name: xAI

source.quote: The transaction values SpaceX at US$1 trillion, and xAI at US$250 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter.

description: Elon Musk's AI company, maker of the Grok models and owner of X; a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX since February 2026.
explain: xAI builds some of the largest GPU supercomputers (Colossus) and buys huge volumes of Nvidia chips; since SpaceX bought it, its spending is funded by SpaceX.
